description: The Bambu Lab H2D is an enclosed dual-nozzle FDM 3D printer. Each nozzle has a single-nozzle build volume of 325 x 320 x 325 mm, and the nozzles reach 350 °C. In a makerspace, students use it to print prototypes, enclosures, fixtures and functional parts. Using two nozzles, they can combine two colours or materials in one print, such as rigid and flexible filament, or use the second nozzle for dissolvable supports.

specs.label: Common print area for both nozzles
Supported nozzle diameters
specs.value: 0.2 mm, 0.4 mm, 0.6 mm, 0.8 mm (0.4 mm included)

specs.label: Supported build plates
specs.value: Textured PEI Plate, Smooth PEI Plate

useRestrictions: Only for students who have completed the lab's 3D printer induction, and the optional laser and cutting modules only for those trained on them by staff.
